messages:
maria-sales: Hey team — AcmeBank POC hitting issues exporting logs from our on-prem gateway to Datadog. Agent keeps failing with TLS handshake errors and 403 on the intake API. Can someone help unblock network/credentials?

kyle-sre: Which agent and config? are you using the dd-agent container or forwarding from our gateway? paste the agent config (redact API key)

maria-sales: forwarding from gateway (java app -> gateway -> dd-forwarder). Config snippet: 
```yaml
outputs:
  datadog:
    api_key: REDACTED
    host: https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com
    use_ssl: true
    timeout: 10s
```
Errors from forwarder logs: 
```
E 2026-03-18 10:12:04 Forwarder - failed to post to intake: TLS handshake error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
E 2026-03-18 10:12:04 Forwarder - upstream returned 403 Forbidden: invalid api key
```

anika-ps: Two likely separate issues: (1) TLS CA bundle on the gateway image is missing or outdated; (2) the API key may be scoped or invalid (Acme asked to rotate keys). Which env is this (staging/prod)?

maria-sales: staging. Acme's security rotated keys yesterday but they confirmed they gave us the new one. We redacted it in the paste.

kyle-sre: Quick checks: 1) run `curl -v --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs` from the gateway host (use the same container). 2) echo the API key header we're sending: `DD-API-KEY: <key>` — Datadog expects `DD-API-KEY` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>` depending on endpoint. Can you paste the exact request headers (redact key)?

maria-sales: Ran curl from container: `curl: (60) SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate`

jorn-platform: That means CA bundle is the culprit. Some older gateway images ship with a minimal CA store and miss Let's Encrypt cross-sigs. We pushed an image with updated ca-certificates last month. Which gateway tag are you on?

maria-sales: gateway:1.2.0

jorn-platform: Ah, 1.2.0 uses an Alpine base that had a broken CA pack. Quick workaround: set `SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` and ensure `ca-certificates` package is installed, or upgrade to gateway:1.3.1 which includes the fix.

gus-security: Also a heads-up from security: we can't accept long-lived plaintext API keys in on-prem config. For AcmeBank we agreed to use an HMAC-signed short-lived token issued by their secrets service + gateway token exchange. Can you confirm if they're doing token exchange or just handing the raw API key?

maria-sales: They gave a long API key. I'll check with them about short-lived tokens. For now we need the POC to complete — can we get a quick mitigation for staging so logs flow?

kyle-sre: For quick POC unblock: 1) upgrade gateway image to 1.3.1 (fixes CA). 2) confirm header is `DD-API-KEY: <key>` and that the key matches Datadog intake (403 indicates Datadog rejecting it). 3) If they rotated keys, exchange the fresh key and test. Command to test from container: `curl -H "DD-API-KEY: $KEY" -X POST "https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs" -d '[{"message":"ping"}]'`

maria-sales: Running that now...

dd-agent-bot: POST 403 from http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs — response: {"errors":[{"message":"invalid api key"}]}

anika-ps: If curl with the same key returns 403, the key is wrong or scoped. Datadog sometimes shows key usage in the org UI — ask Acme to validate the key name and target region (datadoghq.eu vs datadoghq.com). Region mismatch will 403.

maria-sales: Good catch — they're in EU region. We were hitting datadoghq.com. Changing host to https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.eu fixed the 403. TLS still needed update.

kyle-sre: Nice. So plan: upgrade gateway image (or add ca-certificates) and switch intake host to .eu. Also verify header `DD-API-KEY` present and not being stripped by proxy. Last thing: do we propagate trace IDs? Acme asked about correlating request IDs with logs/traces — we need to map our gateway request_id to Datadog trace_id header (x-datadog-trace-id / x-datadog-parent-id) or at least include trace_id in logs as attribute.

maria-sales: They want trace correlation for end-to-end troubleshooting. Current gateway sets `X-Request-Id`. Any suggestions for consistent propagation?

anika-ps: Two options: 1) Have the gateway set `trace.trace_id` in the log JSON payload (Datadog log processing can map it to traces if you set `dd.trace_id` and `dd.span_id`). 2) Forward incoming `X-Request-Id` into Datadog as `attributes.request_id`. If you want automatic APM linking, instrument the app to emit `dd.trace_id` headers. For POC, adding `attributes.request_id` is fastest.

jorn-platform: Example log payload we use: `{
  "message": "user checkout",
  "dd": {"trace_id": "{{trace_id}}", "span_id": "{{span_id}}"},
  "attributes": {"request_id": "{{x-request-id}}"}
}`

maria-sales: OK we'll add `attributes.request_id` and switch host to .eu. Upgrading gateway to 1.3.1 now.

kyle-sre: After upgrade, confirm `curl -v` succeeds and the test POST returns 202 or 200. Also check agent logs for rate limiting headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining`. POCs often hit rate limits during bulk replay.

maria-sales: Post-upgrade test result: `curl` OK, POST returns 202. Agent logs show `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 998` in responses.

gus-security: For enterprise checklist: we still need to document key rotation policy (auto-rotate every 30 days), KMS integration option, and ensure logs do not contain PII. Please send sample redacted log schema to security for approval.

maria-sales: Will send schema. Last ask from Acme: can we export dashboard + trace links for the POC? They want a dashboard that shows errors by request_id with links into traces.

anika-ps: We can make a quick dashboard: logs search by `attributes.request_id:%s` and a log-based metric for error rate. In Datadog you can create a log to trace link using `dd.trace_id` field. If we only have `request_id`, provide a manual link in dashboard that opens the trace search with the same request_id. Quick runbook: 1) add dd.trace_id when instrumenting; 2) create log pipeline to parse `dd.trace_id`; 3) dashboard widget with `link_to_traces('trace_id')`. If they want out-of-the-box linking we need trace ids in the logs.

maria-sales: For the POC we'll include dd.trace_id in a subset of requests. Acme is fine with sample instrumentation. Thanks everyone — this unblocks the staging export. I'll follow up with the security checklist items and send the sample schema.

kyle-sre: Great. If anything else pops up ping #eng-sre or @jorn-platform.

maria-sales: closing the loop — marking this resolved on our side. :white_check_mark:
